name: Miria de Arcadare
original_name: ミリア・ド・アークアデア
source:
The third princess of Arcadare. Despite being very carefree and laidback, Miria is very shy and hasn't talked to the boys before, and thanks to that, she doesn't have much friends. Whenever Miria is with Maria, she hides behind her back, as soon as she meets a stranger, especially a man. However, Miria wants to evolve and gain more courage, thus, she thinks it's finally the time to become braver by talking to Mamoru and his friends. Not to mention, she feels something special for Mamoru...

[Loosely translated from the [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=595945]Getchu Site[/url]]
